RFFC5072.loop_filter_note: Topology (p7/p8 identical): active op-amp integrator between LFILT1 (in) and LFILT2 (out): C8 8.2pF in parallel with series R3 22k + C9 180pF; then 2-pole RC post-filter LFILT2 -R2 470R- (C10 330pF to GND) -R6 470R- LFILT3 with C17 330pF to GND. The synthesizer spec (p3) is quoted for 'loop bandwidth 200 kHz, 52 MHz reference'; typical plots (p9) use 26 MHz and 52 MHz TCXOs (NDK ENA3523A / ENA3560A). With our 40 MHz ref (PFD 40 MHz <= 52 MHz max) and the same charge-pump setting, loop BW scales ~ with f_PFD: ~200*40/52 = ~150 kHz, phase margin roughly kept. Fine to copy the values; charge-pump current is programmable (Slice2 register guide, not downloaded - UNVERIFIED).
RFFC5072.control_note: 3-wire SPI: ENX, SCLK, SDATA to ESP32 GPIOs (+33pF each per eval). RESETX to GPIO with 10k pull-up to DIG_VDD. ENBL and MODE: route to ESP32 GPIOs (or 0R/10k to DIG_VDD/GND); do NOT hard-tie to a rail if firmware sets SDI_CTRL.sipin=1, because they then become outputs GPO5/GPO6 (HackRF-style SPI control). GPO4/LD -> ESP32 GPIO (lock detect) + optional LED. GPO1/2/3 -> test pads. Pins 2,3,11,13,14,17,18,20,21 open; 12 to GND.
notes: DS pin table (p4) names pin 27 MIX2_OPN and pin 28 MIX2_OPP, while the eval schematic (p7) labels pin 27 MIX2_IOIP (net RF_OP2_P) and pin 28 MIX2_IOIN. Polarity only flips IF phase - irrelevant for a balun - but do not rely on the names.
Supply max 3.3 V operating: TPS7A2033 (3.3 V) is at the top of range; TPS7A2030 (3.0 V) is the safer nominal (C963429).
Mixer input return loss spec is for 100 ohm differential; output spec is 'driving 4:1 balun' (200 ohm) - matches BD2425N50200AHF.
UNVERIFIED: DC current through the BD2425 DC-feed pin (mixer output stage bias, set by MIX_IDD) vs the balun's DC rating (not stated in its DS).
